runtime_contract.hardware_policy: Record exact CUDA GPU. H100/H200 is the upstream-matched condition; other BF16-capable CUDA GPUs remain explicit distinct runtime conditions.

execution.repeatability_basis: Phase 2A retained Evidence: 18/18 conditions byte-identical across three repeats.

zero_position.alignment: compare by semantic question_id and option_id

canonical_suffix_shift.suffix_position_ids: canonical sequential position + frozen positive offset
canonical_suffix_shift.suffix_boundary: first token after exact rendered state span
canonical_suffix_shift.alignment: compare against standard packed-canonical by semantic question_id and option_id

invariants: Phase 2C reuses exactly the 3 fixtures and 6 packed question-order conditions frozen by Phase 1C and reused by Phase 2A and Phase 2B.
Phase 2C takes one observation per standard/zero-position condition because Phase 2A already observed exact 3-repeat local repeatability for all 18 conditions.
The released model weights, joint head, tokenizer/processor, dtype, max length, and response head are unchanged from Phase 2B.
Phase 2B Evidence and source files are immutable inputs and are never rewritten by Phase 2C.
Zero-position controls change only explicit position_ids relative to their request-native encoded condition.
Suffix-shift controls start from packed-canonical and change only explicit suffix position_ids after the exact rendered state span.
Synthetic position-ID controls are mechanism probes, not valid provider requests.
No semantic, numerical-noise, sufficiency, necessity, or causality threshold is selected before Phase 2C output.
A non-H100/H200 run remains a distinct runtime condition.
